name: Topoľčany (Slovakia)
description: Chequered blue and yellow in two rows, yellow in the upper hoist, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature T-3/1991.
